pair.title: Connect your OPNsense firewall
pair.intro: Create an API key for a dedicated user on the firewall (System → Access → Users → API keys) and enter it below.
pair.cert_untrusted: This certificate is not signed by a public authority, which is normal for a home firewall. Compare the fingerprint with System → Trust → Certificates on the firewall. Homey will only talk to a firewall presenting exactly this certificate.
pair.missing: Some data will be missing until the API user gets these privileges: __list__
pair.privileges_hint: Recommended privileges for the API user: Lobby: Dashboard, System: Gateways, Status: Services, Diagnostics: Netstat.
pair.error_required: Please fill in the address, key and secret.
pair.error_auth: The firewall rejected the API key or secret.
pair.error_no_privileges: The API user has none of the required privileges. Add at least Lobby: Dashboard and System: Gateways.

device.no_connection: No firewall connection configured. Use Repair.
device.auth_failed: The firewall rejected the API key. Use Repair to enter a new key.
device.cert_changed: The firewall certificate has changed. Use Repair to check and trust the new one.
device.unknown_service: Service __id__ not found on the firewall
device.restart_forbidden: The API user may not restart services (needs Status: Services).

problem.if_errors: __value__ interface errors in the last hour

widget.empty: No OPNsense firewall yet. Add one first.
